subject: Orion Consulting — Redwood integration validation & acceptance checkpoints
messages:
From: Ellen Park <ellen.park@orion-consulting.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>
Cc: Gabe Morris <gabe.morris@cloudsmith.io>
Date: Mon, 3 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Orion x Redwood — integration validation request & POC scope

Hi Priya,

Thanks for the intro during the partner webinar last week — Orion enjoyed the product demo. We’re preparing a short POC to validate a managed connector between Orion’s data enrichment platform and Redwood’s hosted inference endpoints for a joint offering to our enterprise customers.

High-level asks from our side:
- Reference design review (networking, VPC peering options, data flow)
- Validation matrix (latency, throughput, error cases) across Dedicated and Hosted modes
- Test harness / sample dataset recommendations and staging access for a 2-week trial
- A short acceptance checklist we can use to sign off on integration quality

Attached is a one-page integration brief with our proposed data flow and sample payloads. Can we set up a technical validation kickoff next week? We’d like to start the POC by Aug 10 if possible.

Attachments: [Attachment: orion-integration-brief.pdf (PDF)]

Thanks,
Ellen Park
Partnerships Lead | Orion Consulting
ellen.park@orion-consulting.com
+1 (415) 555-0193
From: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>

Cc: Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 3 Aug 2026 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Orion x Redwood — integration validation request & POC scope

Hi Ellen — great to hear from you and glad Orion liked the webinar. We’d be excited to run a short validation POC.

Proposed next steps:
1) Kickoff — 30 minutes technical alignment (we can do Aug 4 or Aug 5).
2) Shared deliverables: we’ll provide a Reference Design doc (network options + firewall matrix), a Validation Checklist template, and a small test harness (curl examples + sample payloads).
3) Environment: we can provision staging endpoints in Hosted mode and temporary Dedicated capacity for the two-week window (we’ll need a short form).
4) Success criteria: run 3 workload profiles (baseline, burst, degraded) and pass the acceptance checklist with no high-severity failures.

I’ve attached the standard partner validation checklist we use as a baseline. Sergio will be our primary technical lead on the POC; Marissa will cover partner ops and billing for any short-term Dedicated commit.

Proposed kickoff: Wed Aug 5 11:00 PST — works for you?

Attachments: [Attachment: validation-checklist.xlsx (XLSX)]

Best,
Priya Natarajan
Partner Programs Manager | Redwood Inference
priya_natarajan@redwood.com
From: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>

Date: Tue, 4 Aug 2026 11:20:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Orion x Redwood — integration validation request & POC scope

Forwarding Orion’s intro — they want to start a 2-week POC around Aug 10. Quick notes / ask:

- Sergio: can you own the Reference Design and validation matrix? Key items: VPC peering vs Private Link (recommendation and firewall rules), routing for prefix caching, and acceptable latencies for Dedicated vs Hosted. Please include a runbook for failing over to a smaller-quantized model if we see perf regressions.
- Marissa: I’ll need a short Dedicated provision quote and any procurement steps (SOW, procurement contact, temporary billing terms). Also confirm whether we can provide short-lived API keys and isolated tenant for staging.

Keep the kickoff short — I’ll be on the call to introduce the partner and align on milestones.

— Priya

Thanks — I’ll own the technical validation. High-level plan attached and summarized below. I can run the kickoff today at 11:00 PST.

Summary plan (short):
- Day 0 (pre-kickoff): exchange staging network details. We need the candidate Orion payloads (sample size ~1k events) and a sample schema.
- Week 1: run baseline throughput (10 qps sustained), then burst (100 qps for 2 min), and error-injection (simulate 5% malformed payloads). Collect token-level latency and error traces.
- Week 2: run Dedicated capacity tests (pinned nodes) and failover scenarios (model variant fallback).
- Acceptance checkpoints: all critical errors resolved, <200ms p50 token latency on baseline in Dedicated, documented rollback steps.

Attachments: [Attachment: validation-checklist.xlsx (XLSX)]

Open questions:
1) Can Orion accept TLS termination on their side and connect to our staging endpoints via mTLS? (prefer mTLS to preserve origin identity)
2) For staging Dedicated, how much vGPU time do we allocate for 2 weeks? I recommend a 1/2-day burn rate estimate in pricing and Marissa can finalize.

If that all looks good I’ll prepare the Reference Design doc (network diagrams + runbook) and a minimal load harness (bash + k6 snippets).

— Sergio
